description_en: Queries the information about a permission policy
description_zh: 调用GetPolicy获取指定的权限策略信息
kebab_example: aliyun resourcemanager get-policy --policy-name OSS-Administrator --policy-type Custom --biz-language zh-CN --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The name of the permission policy.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
权限策略名称。

长度为1~128个字符，可包含英文字母、数字和短划线（-）
parameters.name: policy_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the permission policy. Valid values:

Custom
System
parameters.help_zh:
权限策略类型。取值：

Custom：自定义策略。
System：系统策略
parameters.name: policy_type

parameters.help_en:
The language in which you want to return the description of the system permission policy. Valid values:

en: English
zh-CN: Chinese
ja: Japanese
parameters.help_zh:
语言类型。系统权限策略的描述将以此语言返回。取值：

en：英文。
zh-CN：中文。
ja：日文
parameters.name: language

Policy.description_en: The information about the permission policy

AttachmentCount.description_en: The number of references to the permission policy

CreateDate.description_en: The time when the permission policy was created

DefaultVersion.description_en: The default version of the permission policy

Description.description_en: The description of the permission policy

PolicyDocument.description_en: The document of the permission policy

PolicyName.description_en: The name of the permission policy

PolicyType.description_en:
The type of the permission policy. Valid values:

Custom
System
PolicyType.description_zh:
权限策略类型。取值：

Custom：自定义策略。
System：系统策略

UpdateDate.description_en: The time when the permission policy was updated
